title: visor-plugin.toml
description: A visor Plugin's manifest, written in TOML at the root of the Plugin's directory. This schema checks it decoded to JSON.

name.description: The Plugin's name: lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Installed Plugins live in plugins/<name>/.

protocol.description: The protocol version the Plugin speaks; visor refuses other versions with needs setup.

command.description: The program to run, with its arguments, never through a shell. A path with a slash is relative to the Plugin's directory, which is also its working directory; a bare name is looked up on PATH.

build.description: Steps `visor plugin install` runs in the Plugin's directory, in order, with no stdin and no shell.

widget.description: The Widget types the Plugin provides, as [[widget]] tables.

duration.description: A Go duration such as "30s", "5m" or "1h30m".

type.description: The `type` a [[widget]] block in config.toml names; unique across visor and every Plugin.

title.description: The default title in the Widget's top border.

description.description: One line above the type's block in `visor config default`.

refresh.description: How often visor sends widget/refresh; omitted is only at start and after Actions.

floor.description: The shortest `refresh` a user may set; shorter ones are clamped.

default.description: Place a Widget of this type when config.toml places none.

setting.description: The keys a [[widget]] block of this type takes, as [[widget.setting]] tables.

name.description: The key, other than type, id, title and refresh, which every Widget takes.

kind.description: A secret is a credential visor keeps in the OS keyring, never in config.toml. It takes no default or choices; visor adds a "Set <name>" Widget Action, id `secret:<name>`, that asks for it in a masked prompt, and sends it in widget/open's settings, absent until set. One value per Plugin and name, shared by its Widgets.

why.description: When you'd change it; the config reference prints it.

choices.description: The only values a string setting accepts.

required.description: Add Widget writes the setting, at its default, into the block it appends.

target.description: A secret's page where a user creates the credential, opened as the prompt appears.
